OLT is a treatment option for HCC in cirrhosis provided the disease meets defined clinical and pathological criteria.

OLT is a safe and effective therapy for HCC within the Milan criteria and that preoperative imaging is a useful tool for staging.

the preoperative imaging for HCC staging is a useful tool in selecting patients who may benefit from OLT.

OLT is an effective treatment for selected cases of HCC.
the preoperative diagnosis of HCC is difficult and that the Milan criteria may be too stringent.
